About this episode

Theo Vance joins us to talk about why p99 latency is a story rather than a number, what dashboards hide, and the time a single retry loop took down a payments cluster. We start with the basics at 02:14, get into tail amplification at 18:40, and close with a postmortem reading list at 47:05.
